title_en: Google’s new Gemini model is better at understanding complicated questions
title_zh: Google 新 Gemini 模型更擅长理解复杂问题
summary_en: Google released Gemini 4 Hydrogen, a new model that better handles complex questions by breaking them down and addressing each part, including multi-part queries, typos, and specific requests. It is available in Search, the Gemini app, Google AI Studio, Gemini API, and other services, and is now the default model in AI Mode. The model provides more links via simultaneous queries across subtopics, richer visuals like images and tables, and improved language understanding. It offers thinking levels low, medium, high, and a new 'xhigh' mode, and Google claims it delivers significant leaps in speed and intelligence over Gemini Flash 3.8, matching or outperforming competitors like Claude Sonnet 5.5 and GPT-6.1 Terra.
summary_zh: Google 发布了 Gemini 4 Hydrogen 模型，能更好地处理复杂问题，通过分解问题并逐一回答，包括多部分查询、拼写错误和高度具体的请求。该模型已在搜索、Gemini 应用、Google AI Studio、Gemini API 等服务中上线，并成为 AI 模式的默认模型。它通过同时查询相关子主题提供更广泛的链接，并增加图像、对比表格、图表和地图等视觉内容，同时改进了所有支持语言的理解能力。模型提供低、中、高和新的“xhigh”思考级别，Google 称其在速度和智能上相比 Gemini Flash 3.8 有显著提升，并能匹配或超越 Claude Sonnet 5.5 和 GPT-6.1 Terra 等竞品。
content_en:
Google says its new Gemini 4 Hydrogen model can give more helpful answers to complex questions, including “questions with multiple parts, hard-to-understand typos, or highly specific requests.” The new model can break down your questions and address each part in its responses. It’s available starting today in search, the Gemini app, all tiers of Google AI Studio, the Gemini API, Gemini for business, and in Google Antigravity for Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers. Robby Stein, VP of product at Google Search, says it’s “now the new default model in AI Mode & being used for your hardest questions in AI Overviews.”

# Google’s new Gemini model is better at understanding complicated questions

Google’s Robby Stein says Gemini 4 Hydrogen is ‘the biggest model upgrade to Search yet.’

Google says Gemini 4 Hydrogen also gives users a wider range of links in its responses by “conducting simultaneous queries across all the relevant subtopics.” Its responses have more visuals, too, like images, comparison tables, graphs, and maps. One of Stein’s examples shows the AI generating an interactive animated driving simulation in response to a user’s question about how phones locate which lane of a highway a car is on in areas without cell service. Google says the new model also has improved language understanding “across all supported AI Mode languages.”

Users have more thinking level options with Gemini 4 Hydrogen, as well, including low, medium, high, and a new “xhigh” mode. According to Google, the new model “delivers significant leaps in both speed and intelligence” compared to Gemini Flash 3.8, and it “matches or outperforms some of the competing models in its class,” like Claude Sonnet 5.5 and GPT-6.1 Terra.

content_zh:
谷歌表示，其全新的 Gemini 4 Hydrogen 模型能够针对复杂问题给出更有帮助的回答，包括“包含多个部分的问题、难以理解的拼写错误，或高度具体的请求”。新模型可以拆解你的问题，并在回答中逐一处理每个部分。从今天起，该模型已在搜索、Gemini 应用、Google AI Studio 的所有层级、Gemini API、Gemini for business，以及面向 Google AI Pro 和 Ultra 订阅用户的 Google Antigravity 中上线。Google 搜索产品副总裁 Robby Stein 表示，它“现在是 AI Mode 中的新默认模型，并在 AI Overviews 中用于处理你最棘手的问题。”

# 谷歌的新 Gemini 模型更擅长理解复杂问题

谷歌的 Robby Stein 表示，Gemini 4 Hydrogen 是“迄今为止对搜索最大的一次模型升级”。

谷歌称，Gemini 4 Hydrogen 还能通过“在所有相关子主题上同时发起查询”，在回答中为用户提供更广泛的链接范围。其回答也包含更多可视化内容，例如图片、对比表格、图表和地图。Stein 展示的一个示例中，AI 针对用户关于手机如何在无蜂窝网络服务的区域定位汽车处于高速公路哪条车道的问题，生成了一个交互式动画驾驶模拟。谷歌表示，新模型还提升了“在所有支持的 AI Mode 语言中”的语言理解能力。

用户在使用 Gemini 4 Hydrogen 时也有更多思考层级选项，包括低、中、高，以及全新的“xhigh”模式。据谷歌称，与 Gemini Flash 3.8 相比，新模型“在速度和智能方面都实现了显著飞跃”，并且“达到或超越了同级别一些竞争模型的表现”，例如 Claude Sonnet 5.5 和 GPT-6.1 Terra。
